paper_title: Long-baseline quantum sensor network as dark matter haloscope
notes: Paper reports first long-baseline quantum sensor network search for dark photon dark matter (DPDM) using 15 synchronized atomic magnetometers in Harbin and Suzhou, China (~1700 km separation). Constrains kinetic mixing coefficient ε over mass range 4.1 feV to 2.1 peV (4.1e-15 eV to 2.1e-12 eV). Data points extracted from text: 'constraint ε ≈ 5 × 10^-6 at 2.1 peV' and approximate lower bound from mass range. Figure 3b shows exclusion limits with 95% C.L. The experiment uses a standard halo model with DM density ρ ≈ 0.45 GeV/cm³ (stated in paper). This is a haloscope-type experiment using meter-scale electromagnetic shields and atomic magnetometer networks to detect DPDM-induced magnetic fields. The long baseline enables noise suppression and correlated signal detection.
